acquisition_note: five-minute methods require 300 seconds of EEG
confidence_alignment: probability supporting the original SVM label, not max probability when decisions disagree
deployment_note: retention thresholds are cohort-relative and not training-derived clinical rules
selection: rank participants within each held-out CV repeat using certainty; fractional selection at ties

first_minute_original_label_support.description: Calibrated probability supporting the original first-minute SVM decision

five_minute_label_consensus.description: Greater agreement among five original SVM predictions

five_minute_probability_consistency.description: Lower probability variation across five minutes ranks as more reliable

uncertainty_note: repeated CV correlated; bootstrap resamples participants
